claim: nixpkgs PR #260248 (merged Oct 10 2023) added the boolean option users.users.<name>.linger to NixOS, fixing the 9-year-old issue #3702; it is available since NixOS 23.11
stance_target: jupiterOS fleet configs can and should enable linger declaratively via users.users.<name>.linger = true rather than tmpfiles hacks or imperative loginctl
quoted_support: Adds a new boolean user option, linger, which can be used to enable systemd lingering for individual users. ... Fixes #3702

claim: users.users.<name>.linger is NOT the same as DontKillUserProcesses=true: it is per-user rather than per-system, and lingering users have their slice and services started on boot (or on nixos-rebuild) rather than on first login
stance_target: the declarative linger option is precisely the mechanism that makes user-scoped fleet agents start at boot on headless hosts
quoted_support: This is not the same as DontKillUserProcesses=true; (a) it allows configuration per-user rather than per-system and (b) lingering users will have their slice and services start on boot (or on nixos-rebuild) rather than on first login.

claim: Declarative linger coexists with mutable management: root can still use loginctl to manage lingering, but the configured setting takes precedence whenever nixos-rebuild runs; the implementation diffs /var/lib/systemd/linger against the configured user list and runs loginctl disable-linger on anyone not configured
stance_target: nixos-rebuild will actively disable-linger users not declared in config — fleet configs must declare the agent user or risk losing lingering
quoted_support: Lingering users can still be managed mutably by root with loginctl, but the settings here will take precedence when nixos-rebuild is run. ... ls ${lingerDir} | sort | comm -3 -1 ${lingeringUsersFile} - | xargs -r ${pkgs.systemd}/bin/loginctl disable-linger

claim: The proposal to enable linger by default for isNormalUser users was rejected by the community with 6 thumbs-down reactions (aanderse, tilpner, michalrus, armeenm, ambroisie, SuperSandro2000)
stance_target: NixOS deliberately keeps linger opt-in per-user — fleet configs must enable it explicitly for the agent user; there is no default safety net
quoted_support: Design discussion: proposal to enable linger by default when isNormalUser is set was rejected with 6 thumbs-down (Ralith's suggestion; aanderse, tilpner, michalrus, armeenm, ambroisie, and SuperSandro2000 against).
